title: Double J Ranch Golf Club
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Located in the Texas Hill Country just South of Austin and North of San Marcos, the narrow, 6600-yard Bermuda grass-driven par 72 course at the crossroads of Wimberley and Woodcreek will be a challenging, yet exciting destination for golfers and the community. Don't let the yardage fool you!
